rationale: The body-weight and body-height extensions have StructureDefinitions that require value[x] to be a Reference to Observation resources (per the extension profile definitions in the map documentation). These TODO rules indicate unresolved reference mappings. Without existing Observations or a pattern to create them, no valid value[x] can be written via the map—creating References requires Observation resources that do not exist in this transformation scope. The constraint violations reflect deliberate gaps marked by TODO placeholders rather than fixable mapping errors.
